# Rainmakers

> Rainmakers is an innovation advisor and venture builder & accelerator, active in Milan since 2011 (founded by Francesco Inguscio, formerly Nuvolab): it makes large companies innovative and innovative companies large, and it created Italian Rainforest.

Rainmakers is an entrepreneurial ecosystem, not just a VC fund, accelerator, incubator, consultancy, agency or community: its value is access to people, expertise, opportunities, knowledge and communities.

## Business units
Rainmakers is an integrated venture development organisation (VDO) with six units: Advisory (innovation advisory since 2011, formerly Nuvolab), Investments (investment advisory for VCs, CVCs and family offices), Club (club deal of 300+ entrepreneurs and intrapreneurs), Lab (scaling as a service), Tribe (startups created or accelerated: 6 exits, significant stakes in 14) and Community (networking events, vertical communities, giveback; on the board of InnovUp).

## Track record
- Tribe: https://www.rainmakers.it/en#tribe
- Innovation advisory projects (e.g. Le Village by Crédit Agricole, MCE 4x4 for Assolombarda, iBicocca for University of Milano-Bicocca, Officine Formative for Intesa Sanpaolo, 360 by 360 for 360 Capital Partners): https://www.rainmakers.it/en#advisory

## Who it is for
First of all founders, entrepreneurs and leaders of startups, scaleups and SMEs, intrapreneurs and innovation managers. Also investors, corporates, innovation professionals and ecosystem players (accelerators, incubators, advisors, universities, communities, institutions, service providers).

## What entrepreneurs can access
- Network: entrepreneurs, professionals and innovation players
- Knowledge: content, materials and learning opportunities shared in the ecosystem
- Opportunities: partnerships and connections that support growth
- Community: topic-based and professional WhatsApp communities
- Ecosystem intelligence: Italian Rainforest
- Experience: peers facing similar entrepreneurial paths

## Italian Rainforest
Italian Rainforest (https://italian-innovation-map.vercel.app/en) is the map and database of the Italian innovation ecosystem, created by Rainmakers: investors, incubators and accelerators, startup studios, corporate venture capital, coworking spaces, institutions and other innovation enablers. Open data under a copyleft licence for non-commercial use.

## How the pieces relate
Rainmakers.it (the gateway) → Italian Rainforest (the ecosystem intelligence layer) → WhatsApp communities (the human layer).
